answer_2.quote: We use three metrics - i) FID, ii) Recall@k, and iii) Relational-similarity (rsim). FID measures the realism of the generated images.

answer_4.quote: The study achieved a high average Fleiss' kappa score of 0.646, indicating strong inter-evaluator agreement. Evaluators were asked two binary questions, each requiring a 'yes' (1) or 'no' (0) response, to assess the models: (Q1) Does the model perform the desired change mentioned in the input instruction?, (Q2) Does the model not introduce any undesired change elsewhere in the image?
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators answered two binary questions about (Q1) desired change correctness and (Q2) absence of undesired changes.
